sources.title: Exact repository interview-question source and Batch 0033 boundary audit
Mode-set median deterministic Java validation against independent TreeMap oracle

claims.text: The exact repository source asks for the mode(s) of a given array and the median among those mode values; element type, tied-mode output shape, even-cardinality median semantics, invalid-input behavior and Java API are not preserved source constraints.

Under the explicit answer-side contract, the implementation counts frequencies, collects every value tied at the maximum frequency, sorts those values, and returns their positional median using overflow-safe arithmetic for the even case.

Compiled Java validation passes five fixed edge cases, null/empty rejection, an Integer.MIN_VALUE/Integer.MAX_VALUE overflow case, and all 9,840 arrays of lengths 1 through 8 over {-1,0,1} against an independent TreeMap frequency oracle.
